Sheet: Summary. Field: S106.1 - Summary. Field: How to use the Mission Form template. Field: Purpose. Field: This template is part of the Stand-by support process defined in §3.10 QHB-OR.. Field: It is governed by the On-Call Support and Production Monitoring internal regulation. Field: It must be filled by Delivery Unit or Department heads ("DH" in the following). Field: It is kept and archived by the Compensation & Benefits responsible in the HR Department: Mrs. Hang (LHG) or "HR" in the following. Field: Employee list. Field: Form "Employee List" must be filled first with the visa, name and contact information of all employees subject to on-call support or emergency maintenance work during the period. A maximum of 10 employees can be entered. In case more are necessary, use separate mission forms.
The Delivery Unit and project name must be specified.. Field: On-Call Support Planning. Field: 0 — Value: This form must be filled, printed and signed before the stand-by support starts.. Field: 1 — Value: Fill-in the period (date from and to) that this planning covers. Field: 2 — Value: Indicate the applicable SLA (see the On-Call Support and Production Monitoring internal regulation for details). Field: 3 — Value: For each support window, enter the following:. Field: -  Visa of the employee (must be in the "Employee List" form). Field: -  On-call support date. Field: -  On-call support period start time. Field: -  On-call support period end time. Field: -  Whether the employee is on approved annual leave on that date. Field: Notes:. Field: -  If the period spans across several days, enter one line per day. Field: -  The date must be within the planning period (specified in point 1 above) or it will turn red. Field: - On working days, the support period must not overlap normal working hours (9h-18h) or it will turn red. Field: 4 — Value: Send the form to the requestor in CH and obtain approval. Field: 5 — Value: Print the form and the CH requestor's approval. Field: 6 — Value: All employees who appear in the "Employees prior consent" section sign. Field: 7 — Value: The DH signs. Field: 8 — Value: Submit the form together with the approval from the requestor in CH to HR both in electronic and in paper format.. Field: 9 — Value: HR will seek approval from the HR Manager and the General Director and inform the DH of the outcome. Field: 10 — Value: In case an update is necessary that requires additional on-call support work from any employee (employee sickness, resignation, change in business plans, etc...), the form must be updated and resubmitted for approval from CH, employees, HR and GD before the modified support date. 
Support time reductions or cancellations do not necessitate re-approval. 
Last-minute changes that cannot reasonably be pre-approved due to the urgent nature of the situation are approved by the DH the next day and communicated to HR.. Field: On-Call Support Actual Time. Field: 1 — Value: After the support period, HR sends the "On-Call Support Actual Time" form to the DH. The form is pre-filled with the data from the approved "On-Call Support Planning" form.. Field: 2 — Value: Fill-in the "On-Call Support Activity" section as follows:. Field: - Edit the pre-filled "Actual Time Spent" section if necessary (in case there are differences with the approved plan). Field: - Input the "Emergency Response" section with the time spent by employees on incidents resolution while they were on-call. The "Incident Ref (Jira)" column must contain links to the support ticket created by the customer and on which the employee worked. HR must have access to these links for control purposes.. Field: 3 — Value: Fill-in the "Voluntary emergency response outside of on-call support hours" section as follows:. Field: - Input the employee's visa, date, start time and end time of emergency response work, and whether the employee was on annual leave on that date. Field: - Indicate who asked the employee to work voluntarily on emergency response. It can be another employee who was on-call but couldn't solve the issue by himself, or the employee's supervisor, or directly the customer.  The "Incident Ref (Jira)" column must contain links to the support ticket created by the customer and on which the employee worked. HR must have access to these links for control purposes.. Field: 4 — Value: Print the form. The DH signs the form and gets all volunteers who worked on emergency response outside of on-call support hours to sign.. Field: 5 — Value: Submit the form to HR, both in electronic and in paper format.. Field: 6 — Value: Compensation will be paid to employees with the first payroll following the support period..
